branch.value: taken iff rep == 0 or rep > p//2 (signed <= 0)

gfAdd.value: parent-supplied carry-free (verified 0 errors / 80k pairs); replaces author variants 1+2 pending author fix

gfMul.value: double-and-add via gfAdd (verified 0 errors / 80k pairs); variant 1's uint(128) form does not compile on Chapel 2.10

gfSub.value: author variant 1, verbatim (verified 0 errors / 80k pairs); gfSub(x,y) = (x-y) mod p
